ModMetaData.name: Choose Wild Animal Spawns
ModMetaData.author: Mlie
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Self-Info.png[/img] This mod is a successor to claustros mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2067667371]Disable Wild Animal Spawns[/url]
The major difference is that this version allows you to define the spawn-rate per biome per animal instead of the on/off selection. The other difference it that you can modify any animal, vanilla and modded.
Added a slider for the overall animal density per biome as well. Also option to copy values between biomes. There is also a reverse option to select an animal and define spawnrate per biome.
If you need higher accuracy than what the sliders provide, try adding the [url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2218078784]BetterSliders[/url] mod
